scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0124; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target lines ‘This is my friend, Nora.’ and ‘Yes. Nora is my friend.’ are short, natural spoken uses of friend in the intended sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps friend to «دوست» and keeps the same bounded sense across dialogue and activities.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One lexical sense is introduced, recognized, practiced in a guided exchange, transferred to a second context, and retrieved without the answer shown first.

distractorQuality.evidence: Choice distractors are grammatical or context-plausible alternatives and now have distinct explanatory feedback.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: نینا و آیریس در ورودی مرکز محله با نورا روبه‌رو می‌شوند و نینا او را به آیریس معرفی می‌کند.

difficultyFit.evidence: Learner responses stay short and controlled, with familiar A1 sentence frames and one new lexical target.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: friend recurs across recognition, listening, dialogue, transfer, and hidden spoken retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner turn changes the immediate referent/context while preserving the same bounded sense of friend.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, target construction, scenario, learner turns, activities, and final retrieval all assess the same lexical objective; the community arc returns after five Lessons with the played role changed from Iris to Nina.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; engagement and perceived difficulty remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded A1 lexical sense defined for this Lesson is reviewed.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: English turns and response options were checked for grammar and naturalness.
Persian orthography and English–Persian meaning consistency were checked.
Reference key, part of speech, sense key, and provisional spec hash were cross-checked against the worker packet.
Final retrieval keeps the answer hidden before attempt.
Story arc, participant set, continuation dependency, five-Lesson return distance, review link, and learner-role rotation were repaired to match the canonical community narrative.
